subtitle: My name is Gustavo, I'm a Software developer and this is my website!
intro_1: Passionate about technology since childhood, always solving problems that some family members couldn't, and always wondering how things worked. In 2017 I had my first contact with programming at IFS, where I fell in love with software development.
intro_2: Today, I have over 5 years of experience creating robust and high-performance solutions for the web. My journey ranges from building complex interfaces to architecting scalable systems, working as a Full Stack developer (React + Go + SQL). I work heavily with Go (Golang) for at least 3 years on the backend and in the modern JavaScript ecosystem on the frontend.
